general: Articles are the products or services that are bought or sold. Below, the import template for articles is described at field level.
Basiseenheid and BTW-Tariefgroep are filled with a code from the Hulptabellen tab of this template — not with the description next to it.

Itemcode.description: The unique code under which the article is created in AFAS. Each row must have a different item code.

Omschrijving.description: The description of the article, as it appears on quotes and invoices.

Voorraad bijhouden.description: Indicates whether AFAS keeps track of the stock of this article: J for yes, N for no.

Artikelgroep.description: The code of the article group this article falls under, as already set up in AFAS.

Basiseenheid.description: The unit in which the article is registered, as a code from the Hulptabellen tab (e.g. STK, KG, DOZ, L).

BTW-Tariefgroep.description: The VAT rate group of the article, as a code from the Hulptabellen tab: 0 = zero, 1 = low, 2 = high, Geen = no VAT, U = excluded from VAT/ICP. Leave empty when unknown.

faq.question: Which codes may I use for Basiseenheid and BTW-Tariefgroep?
faq.answer: Exactly the codes from the Hulptabellen tab of this template, not the description next to it — for example STK for Stuks (pieces) or 1 for Laag (low).
